notes.title: Last Hotfix Before The Revolution
notes.notes:
- Sound fixes throughout the map and also some additions for ambiance
- AI bug fixes (not searching for player, if the player is not in its patrol area) 
- You can hide  from Wendigo in the bushes


 The map time is at night now

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43361700/365602d3af4ae982feef11883056eced811419ef.png


 Item is added "Sound Trap"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43361700/b848352c5da7916b653e2f5cc5fb7686f4e69b7a.gif


  Another new corridor is added to mansion (for future development :))

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43361700/800accbc2ba98e246069e69572b3ab211083a2e5.png





With that fix, the most problems about the gameplay is handled finally :)) We do appreciate all the support and the feedback you have been giving us for this two weeks, since the launch of the game. The positive comments showed us that we could give the necessary vibe players want and the negative comments showed us that we needed some serious work with all the bugs, gameplay, and environment. That was the main reason we have launched the game in an early phase for getting all the feedbacks, because you cant understand what you are doing while you are working on the same stuff after hours and hours everyday. We will be away for a while to work on the next big update for now and because of the redesign and recode we will be dealing, its gonna pass like a month period of time till the next patch and lastly, new maps with different topics and gameplays will be ready within this period too...Ok then, hope to meet you again.

notes.title: Restricted Footage-Hotfix 1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone , we made a new patch today , some bug fixes and some additions that you might like
-Wendigo return to his hive after a shutdown and also does not get blocked by anyone anymore
-Wendigo 2 (basement one) does not get stuck in certain places like before
-Slide is possible now if you crouch while running 
-Can not open or close doors while you are down
-We added some more npc to test out how they will fit in the game , and if you like maybe more npc to come with more aggresive talents in the future , they are not for now cause we do not want them to make the game harder before we fix the main problems 
-You have more view in the screen when you carry the gasoline now, the thing about that is: according to the experience we want you to have ,you have a body cam and you are carrying a huge can of  gasoline so it should block a lot of view for the player , but we fix it anyway just think about it before you criticize 
-We added a huge truck in the entrance in order to make runaway easier from the Wendigo at outside
-Added a second entrance to the mansion 
-Running is now possible  while you re holding a fuse or a key ,but not with the gasoline cause its meant to be that way 
-Performance issues are mostly fixed , much better fps now as we test it out, but please give us feedback in bug report channel if you still have huge fps dropdowns
--The inventory bug is still there and we will be working to fix it next patch
--Sound problem in some areas will be fixed in next patch for sure
--The Ai problems are tough ones for us but we will be making it better in the future for sure
